insight: Rebranded from Adobe Spark in 2021-22, inheriting that app's templates before Firefly AI was bolted on.
name: Adobe Express
tagline: Quick-design app with Firefly generative AI, templates, and brand kits.
description: Adobe's lightweight design app for social graphics, flyers, videos, and PDFs, combining thousands of templates with Firefly-powered generative AI. Features include text-to-image, generative fill, background removal, text effects, and brand kits. It pairs a free tier with a Premium plan and is included with most Adobe Creative Cloud subscriptions.

modelSupport.notes: Generative features run on Adobe Firefly models trained on licensed and public-domain content.

edge: The templates-and-brand-kit front end to Adobe's licensed-trained Firefly models, bundled with most Creative Cloud plans.
pros: Firefly generative AI is commercially safer
Thousands of templates and brand kits
Free tier; included with Creative Cloud
Web plus iOS and Android apps
cons: Lighter than full Creative Cloud apps
